title: Within-Session Repeatability of EUS-Guided Portal Pressure Gradient Measurement
official: Within-Session Repeatability and Inter-Operator Reproducibility of EUS-Guided Portal Pressure Gradient Measurement: A Prospective Multicentre Study
summary: This prospective multicentre observational reliability study will determine how much a repeated endoscopic ultrasound-guided portal pressure gradient (EUS-PPG) measurement differs from the first measurement in the same patient during the same procedural session. Each participant will undergo two complete EUS-PPG measurement sets using an identical 22-gauge measurement setup. The study will quantify within-session repeatability when the same expert performs both sets and inter-operator reproducibility when different operators perform the sets.

interventions.name: Repeated EUS-Guided Portal Pressure Gradient Measurement

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Clinical indication for EUS-guided portal pressure gradient measurement established independently of the study
* Written informed consent, including consent for the additional measurement set

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindication to endoscopy, sedation, or endosonography-guided vascular puncture
* Non-correctable coagulation disorder
* Hemodynamic instability at the time of the procedure
* Any intervention between the two measurement sets that may alter portal pressure, including fluid administration beyond maintenance requirements, vasoactive substances, paracentesis, or variceal band ligation
* Technically non-evaluable first measurement set
* Pregnancy or breastfeeding
* Inability to provide informed consent
